description: Human approval lane allows approved actions, denies rejected actions, and applies fail mode on expiry.
laneYaml:
id: rt-human-approval
version: 1
priority: 2000
mode: enforce+approval
purpose: Require dashboard approval for deployment-like shell commands.
appliesTo: { surfaces: [claude-code], agents: ['rt-human-approval'] }
failMode: { default: closed, READ: open, EXEC: closed }
rules:
  deny: []
  allow: []
  judge: []
  approve:
    - id: deploy-needs-human
      tool: [Bash]
      command: ['deploy']
defaultVerdict: allow
approval: { channels: [dashboard], timeoutSec: 1 }
judge: { escalateBelow: 0.7, dataPolicy: redacted }
